environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EKS with IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA). The pod's IAM role has a broad DynamoDB policy: Action=dynamodb:GetItem on Resource=arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/user-profiles. No condition keys restrict which items can be accessed. The upstream gRPC service (user-service) does not validate or sanitize incoming metadata headers. Network policy allows all pod-to-pod traffic within the namespace. No API gateway or ingress controller performs header sanitization.
